data.description:
# AC2: Session-level assignee release backstop

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A shared release helper in `skill/shared/claim_release.py` provides `release_session_claim` that releases the session's claim on normal end-of-session.
2. A `signal_release` SIGINT/SIGTERM guard is available for skill scripts.
3. The end-of-session report (`skill/report/scripts/render_report.py`) invokes the backstop (opt-out with `--no-release-claim`).
4. Read-only lifecycles (`refactor`, `find-related`) hold the signal guard.
5. A regression test drives the helper through both the normal end-of-session path and an interrupting signal, asserting the persisted assignee is empty.
6. `skill/shared/tests/test_claim_release.py` covers session release, real-store signal kill, and signal guard.

## Key Files
- `skill/shared/claim_release.py`
- `skill/report/scripts/render_report.py`
- `skill/report/tests/test_render_report.py`
- `skill/shared/tests/test_claim_release.py`
- `skill/find-related/scripts/find_related.py`
- `skill/refactor/scripts/refactor.py`

## Notes
Implementation already exists in worktree branch `wl-SA-0MW0F91KN004J06U-remove-assignee-when-a-session-finishes` (commit `7fdd6585c`).
data.title: AC2: Session-level assignee release backstop
